tasks.description: A reusable Rust runtime policy, unique runtime identity, and full-lifecycle profile lease are available to BrowserRunner and automation workflows without mutating source profile metadata.
steps: Run targeted Rust tests for persistent metadata preservation, runtime identity uniqueness, ephemeral cleanup/recovery, and stable versus random fingerprint resolution.
Run targeted Rust tests proving concurrent lease rejection and reacquisition after success, cancellation, launch failure, panic/drop, and cleanup failure.
Run cargo fmt --all -- --check and the focused clippy target after pnpm copy-proxy-binary.

tasks.description: Account Checker accepts the shared runtime policy, can select an existing profile, applies effective VPN overrides, and reports guarded cleanup failures while preserving generated-worker fallback.
steps: Run focused Account Checker tests for selected-profile validation, effective VPN application, generated-worker ownership, cancellation, and cleanup diagnostics.
Confirm the selected profile metadata and persistent data path are unchanged before and after a successful and failed check.

depends_on: Shared runtime launch policy and profile lease

tasks.description: Auto Registration exposes its existing profile selection through the normal request/UI boundary and runs adopted profiles through immutable runtime overlays with lease-protected cleanup.
steps: Run registration tests proving selected-profile concurrency above one is rejected, source metadata is restored byte-for-byte, and only owned generated workers are deleted.
Run registration lifecycle tests for relaunch fingerprint renewal, ephemeral data isolation, cancellation, launch failure, and cleanup failure.
Verify existing-account 2FA backfill dispatch still bypasses new-account quota/provider paths.

depends_on: Shared runtime launch policy and profile lease
Account Checker profile reuse vertical slice

tasks.description: Auto Login accepts an explicit profile/runtime policy, replaces implicit unleased name reuse with an explicit default, and keeps network and fingerprint overrides task-local.
steps: Run login tests proving explicit profile validation, same-profile concurrent rejection, and lease release after normal and failed login termination.
Verify stable-worker default behavior remains available when no profile is selected and does not select a different user's profile by name alone.
Verify task-local network/fingerprint settings do not persist to the selected source profile.

depends_on: Shared runtime launch policy and profile lease

tasks.description: 2FA Backfill uses the shared runtime policy while preserving serial execution, canary/bulk gates, recovery journals, ownership checks, secret-free events, and guarded cleanup.
steps: Run backfill tests for selected-profile serialization, operation ownership, stale recovery, cancellation, and cleanup refusal on ownership mismatch.
Verify progress events and recovery summaries remain free of passwords, OTP/TOTP material, access tokens, raw provider responses, and raw HTML.

depends_on: Shared runtime launch policy and profile lease

tasks.description: All four dialogs and event hooks expose profile, data-mode, fingerprint-mode, and compatible network controls with server-validated Tauri requests and no raw user-facing strings.
steps: Run pnpm lint:js and verify all four dialogs type-check with the backend request shapes.
Manually verify profile list refresh, stale-profile rejection, translated validation/error states, keyboard access, and incompatible concurrency behavior.
Run pnpm check-unused-commands.

depends_on: Account Checker profile reuse vertical slice

tasks.description: The new policy terminology, errors, and workflow lifecycle are translated in all seven locales and documented consistently for persistent and ephemeral modes and kernel capabilities.
steps: Validate every new key exists and is non-empty in all seven locale files.
Run the repository spellcheck/lint path and review the documentation against the implemented kernel capability matrix.

depends_on: Frontend profile policy controls and Tauri wiring

tasks.description: The completed migration has reproducible verification evidence covering frontend, Rust, command registration, tests, formatting, and documentation consistency.
steps: Run pnpm copy-proxy-binary before proxy-dependent Rust checks.
Run pnpm format.
Run pnpm lint.
Run pnpm test.
Run pnpm check-unused-commands.
Review git diff --stat, git status --short, and the complete bead artifact set; confirm unrelated pre-existing changes remain untouched.

patterns: BrowserRunner centralizes browser launch, fingerprint regeneration, process lifecycle, pre-launch rollback, and ephemeral directory handling.
ephemeral_dirs.rs provides transactional runtime directory replacement, deletion retries, startup recovery, and effective-path resolution.
Two-factor backfill uses BrowserCleanupGuard, ownership checks, rollback, and stale recovery.
Auto Registration tracks worker_profile_id and owns_worker_profile for generated versus user-provided workers.
Tauri listeners are installed asynchronously before work starts, as shown by use-extension-events.ts.
User-facing frontend strings are translated across seven locale files.
nonGoals: New fingerprint-generation algorithms or browser kernels
Concurrent execution against one selected source profile
Unrelated OpenAI provider, authentication, quota, inventory, or journal redesign
